interpolation: Use a single monotonic interpolation weight for camera and target; gentle ease with nonzero endpoint velocity, no overshoot, no handheld roll. Render 180-degree shutter motion blur if affordable.

shots.name: 从南门启程
shots.intent: Gentle left-to-right crane frames the open stone gateway, official calligraphic gold name, paired columns and adjoining campus buildings.
shots.risk: Refined gate reaches z22.1. Camera backed away and lens widened to43mm, with target raised to11.8–12m so the new lettering stays in-frame. Minimum camera z31; no forward crossing of the gateway. Confirm all three storyboard frames after rebuild.

shots.risk: Refined round hall reaches z23.51; camera stays z69–75. Widened to47mm and end target lowered toz6 after frame240 clipped the lake terrace. Actual22.65m terrace arc projects with positive lower-frame clearance at all three sampled poses. Verify the full curved roof and terrace in replacement samples.

shots.risk: Library west frontage is approximately x145; the camera stops at x60. The 36-step stair, open crown and blue curtain wall are the visual checks. Endpoint crops some outer wings intentionally; confirm roof title remains visible.

shots.name: 学科群像
shots.intent: Northbound lateral track follows the pale yellow academic buildings, local orange entrance frames and connecting upper volumes from the wooded eastern side.
shots.risk: Ding hill terrain is inferred rather than surveyed. Camera z65–69 remains above the modeled hill and canopy. Keep the academic fronts readable; verify trees do not fill the entire foreground.

shots.name: 向活力北区升起
shots.intent: Forward crane rises past the unequal silver new-gym roofs and open court, then reveals the recovered old gym, curved western grandstand canopy and athletics oval.
shots.risk: New gym reaches aboutz21.3; old gym and western grandstand canopy remain belowz18.4. Camera z112–151 provides vertical clearance. The southeast viewpoint sees the photo-supported opposite gym facade; verify the old gym and curved grandstand do not become cropped or occluded.

shots.name: 全校展开
shots.intent: Slow pullback and lift opens the complete campus footprint for the closing njupt-map brand shot.
shots.risk: The campus footprint is unchanged; prior16:9 boundary fit provides the starting camera. Recheck the new full-scene render. Surrounding city remains outside the modeled scope, so keep attention on the campus and avoid unnecessary empty horizon.

on_screen_copy_policy: njupt-map brand and campus name only; no explanatory digital-campus labels. Preserve the existing closing map attribution.
